// Generated by tsverify — do not edit. `tsverify test` deletes and rewrites this directory on every run.
// Spec: src/orders/order.behavior.yaml (behavior "Order lifecycle")
// Source: finding implementation-property:Order lifecycle:rule:Refund issued at most once per order
//   Rule "Refund issued at most once per order" (always: count(effect stripe.refund) <= 1) is violated: a reachable state breaks it.
//   Replays its code-model counterexample against the real code (sidecar: replay-1.json).
import { expect, test, vi } from "vitest";
import {
  instrument,
  mappingFromCode,
  planFromTrace,
  type ReplayResult,
  replayResult,
  scheduler,
} from "@tsverify/runtime";
import sidecar from "./replay-1.json" with { type: "json" };

declare module "vitest" {
  interface TaskMeta {
    /** Read back by `tsverify test`: the verdict, plus the stored status and effect counts it saw. */
    tsverifyReplay?: ReplayResult & {
      status: unknown;
      effects: Record<string, number>;
    };
  }
}

// (1) Fakes as plain top-level consts (vi.mock is hoisted, but its factory runs lazily).
const s = scheduler();
const stripe = instrument.effects(s, { client: "stripe", calls: ["refunds.create"] });
const storage = instrument.storage(s, {
  entity: "Order",
  state: "status",
  binding: {
    key: "id",
    read: [{ ref: { file: "src/orders/repo.ts", symbol: "getOrder" }, args: ["key"] }],
    save: [{ ref: { file: "src/orders/repo.ts", symbol: "saveOrder" }, args: ["entity"] }],
    update: [{ ref: { file: "src/orders/repo.ts", symbol: "setStatusIf" }, args: ["key", "from", "to"] }],
    atomic: [{ ref: { file: "src/db.ts", symbol: "withTransaction" }, args: ["callback"] }],
  },
});

// (2) The modules of the clients (bindings.clients) and of the storage functions (bindings.storage), relative to this file.
vi.mock("../../../src/db.ts", async (importOriginal) => ({
  ...(await importOriginal<Record<string, unknown>>()),
  withTransaction: storage.functions.withTransaction,
}));
vi.mock("../../../src/orders/repo.ts", async (importOriginal) => ({
  ...(await importOriginal<Record<string, unknown>>()),
  getOrder: storage.functions.getOrder,
  saveOrder: storage.functions.saveOrder,
  setStatusIf: storage.functions.setStatusIf,
}));
vi.mock("../../../src/payments/stripe.ts", async (importOriginal) => ({
  ...(await importOriginal<Record<string, unknown>>()),
  stripe: stripe.client,
}));

// (3) The impls, imported dynamically after (1).
const { refundOrder } = await import("../../../src/orders/refund.ts");

// (4) Fixtures (the spec's `fixtures`).
const ID = "order_1";
const ENTITY = { id: "order_1", chargeId: "ch_1" };

/** One invocation per transition the counterexample's workers perform. */
const INVOKE: Record<string, () => Promise<unknown>> = {
  refund: () => refundOrder(ID), // no actor argument
};

const plan = planFromTrace(sidecar.trace, mappingFromCode(sidecar.code));
// step 1 (pay#1 atomic) fast-forwarded: seed status "paid"
// step 2  refund#1 read   → [refund#1, storage.getOrder]
// step 3  refund#2 read   → [refund#2, storage.getOrder]
// step 4  refund#1 write  → [refund#1, storage.saveOrder]
// step 5  refund#2 write  → [refund#2, storage.saveOrder]
// then each worker runs until done: refund#1, refund#2

const PROPERTY = "rule \"Refund issued at most once per order\" (always: count(effect stripe.refund) <= 1)";

/** The entity's status as stored now. */
function stored(): unknown {
  return storage.read("Order", ID)?.status;
}

/** Effect calls by gate: the fast-forwarded prefix's counts plus the calls in this run. */
function observedEffects(): Record<string, number> {
  const counts: Record<string, number> = { ...plan.seedEffects };
  for (const call of s.effects()) counts[call.effect] = (counts[call.effect] ?? 0) + 1;
  return counts;
}

test("replay: rule \"Refund issued at most once per order\" (refund#1 ∥ refund#2)", async ({ task }) => {
  s.reset();
  storage.seed({ Order: [{ ...ENTITY, status: plan.seedStatus }] });
  for (const w of plan.workers) {
    const call = INVOKE[w.transition];
    if (call === undefined) throw new Error(`no invocation for ${w.transition}`);
    s.spawn(w.id, call);
  }
  const outcome = await s.tryPlay(plan.schedule);
  await s.drain();
  const status = stored();
  const effects = observedEffects();
  // rule "Refund issued at most once per order" (always: count(effect stripe.refund) <= 1)
  const violated = !((effects["stripe.refunds.create"] ?? 0) <= 1);
  const result = replayResult(outcome, violated);
  task.meta.tsverifyReplay = { ...result, status, effects };
  const why = `${result.verdict}: the real code violates ${PROPERTY}\n${result.divergence?.message ?? ""}`;
  expect(result.violated, why.trim()).toBe(false);
});
